name: Poker Playing
overview: Scripture warns against the desire for quick riches and covetousness, emphasizing the importance of honest labor and trusting God with our efforts. The commandment not to covet reminds believers to guard their hearts against greed, while Proverbs highlights that wealth gained hastily or by vanity will not endure. Instead, committing one’s work to the Lord leads to stability and blessing, contrasting sharply with the folly of pursuing riches through gambling or speculative means like poker playing.
